title: Monster reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- monster body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="30" ry="26" fill="#47D16C"/>
  <!-- monster head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="22" fill="#5CE07D"/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <polygon points="34,22 28,6 42,18" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <polygon points="66,22 72,6 58,18" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="34" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="34" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#283B8A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#283B8A"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="33.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="33.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M40,46 Q50,56 60,46" stroke="#283B8A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little teeth -->
  <polygon points="46,50 48,55 50,50" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="50,50 52,55 54,50" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#47D16C" transform="rotate(-20 26 72)"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#47D16C" transform="rotate(20 74 72)"/>
  <!-- book cover -->
  <rect x="28" y="66" width="44" height="30" rx="3" fill="#E84545"/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x="32" y="70" width="36" height="22" rx="2" fill="#FFF4D6"/>
  <!-- book center spine -->
  <rect x="49" y="70" width="2" height="22" fill="#D9C49A"/>
  <!-- book text lines -->
  <rect x="35" y="74" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <rect x="35" y="79" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <rect x="35" y="84" width="10" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <rect x="53" y="74" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <rect x="53" y="79" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <rect x="53" y="84" width="9" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B8A88A"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="94" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#2FB558"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="94" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#2FB558"/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="70" r="3" fill="#8CF5A7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="76" r="4" fill="#8CF5A7"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="88" r="2.5" fill="#8CF5A7"/>
</svg>
